requires.reason: YUA's unique NPC base is enrolled as the living-world actor.

_: YUA external-follower enrollment MVP + P1 interactions. Requires installing YUA Follower ESL first. The livingNpcs macro fills YUA through uniqueActor:YUA_Follower.esp:0x000800, rotates her abstract off-stage deeds, materializes her in the Bannered Mare, exposes tavern rumors, and gives fund/praise interactions. The alias controller yields completely while YUA is the player's teammate and resumes after dismissal.

npcs.name: Mira Snow-Voice
npcs.greeting: You hear all kinds of things when you sit near the fire.

placements._: Custom rumor speaker for the MVP, so we do not inject dialogue into a vanilla Bannered Mare NPC yet.

npcs.name: YUA
npcs.backstory: A bright young swordswoman in knightly armor who takes dangerous contracts around Whiterun and tries to make the work look easier than it is.
rumors: That young woman in the white armor? She came back through the gate after midnight with frost on her sword.
YUA called it a few bandits. The caravan folk called it a rescue.
Some say she's too young to take those contracts alone. Funny thing is, she keeps coming back.
